name: Service Fusion
summary: Field service software with unlimited users on every plan.
differentiator: Unlimited users on every plan, so cost rises with feature tier and not with headcount, unlike the per-user and per-technician models elsewhere.
pricing: Starter $208, Plus $325, Pro $533 a month on annual billing (a 15% discount). Monthly billing is $245, $382 and $627. Unlimited users on every plan.
